ruleDefinitions.name: Vim GTFOBin Abuse - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of "vim" and it's siblings commands to execute a shell or proxy commands.
Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/rvim$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vim$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vimdiff$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\!\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:lua\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:py\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/dash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/fish.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh.*")))
